title: The Case of the Vanishing Cameo
story: Thanksgiving afternoon at the Gull's Rest Inn: the turkey was resting, and so were the guests. Then Priya's heirloom cameo brooch vanished, velvet pouch and all, from the parlor mantel. Five guests had settled in the parlor, each at a different time, with a different drink and a different book from the shelf. The pouch turned up, empty, tucked inside the parlor's almanac. Who tucked the cameo away?
